metadata.description: Ultimatum: plain-chat workflows for Claude Code. The core plugin handles code; Ultimatum Launch adds business, website, marketing, motion and film teams that wait for your approval, and the Website, E-commerce and SaaS Launch plugins add a deeper manager for each kind of launch.

plugins.name: ultimatum
plugins.description: Developer workflows for Claude Code: a local router sends coding, debugging, CI, UI, security and release work to /ultimatum:work. Every claim is backed by a check it ran.

plugins.name: ultimatum-launch
plugins.description: Launch teams for Ultimatum: intake, business and brand, website, marketing, motion graphics and brand films. Every spend, post and deploy waits for your yes.

plugins.name: ultimatum-website-launch
plugins.description: Website Launch for Ultimatum: a manager built for small business, local service, portfolio and creator sites. Deeper intake, pages and local SEO, and a launch-day checklist; it runs the shared Ultimatum Launch teams and waits for your yes.

plugins.name: ultimatum-ecommerce-launch
plugins.description: E-commerce Launch for Ultimatum: a manager built for online stores. Platform choice, catalog and product pages, payments, tax, shipping and policies, and a store launch checklist; it runs the shared Ultimatum Launch teams and waits for your yes.

plugins.name: ultimatum-saas-launch
plugins.description: SaaS Launch for Ultimatum: a manager built for software and app products. Pricing and billing, sign-up and activation, trust and security basics, and a launch-week plan; it runs the shared Ultimatum Launch teams and waits for your yes.
